messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=runtime-api image=redwood/runtime:v2.14.0-canary-rc3 env=staging region=us-west-2 change_window=23:00-03:00
alice.nguyen: Ack, watching logs + traces. rolling out to 10% instances.
samir: Running 5m load steady-state now. will report back.
sre-bot: Canary health check (initial): latency_p50=42ms p95=210ms errors=0.2% (baseline p95=190ms) — flagging trend for review.
jordan: I see a small p95 spike in us-west-2 correlated with KV cold miss. warming cache on canaries.
tasha: Quick Q — do we pause promotion automatically if errors > 0.5%? what's our hard gate?
alice.nguyen: Gate = errors < 0.5% AND p95 <= 1.3x baseline for 5m.
sre-bot: Canary health check (2m): errors=0.35% p95=225ms. within gate but trending up.
jordan: I pushed a token-handling tweak (commit 3f7a9b) that should reduce KV pressure. it's low-risk, but would need another canary to validate.
release-manager: Proposal: hold automatic promotion for 10m while Samir runs the extended load test and Jordan watches logs. if stable, promote.
samir: Extended load test finished: 10m steady-state stable. errors=0.12% p95=200ms.
alice.nguyen: LGTM to promote -> prod. tagging image redwood/runtime:v2.14.0-canary-rc3 -> prod tag v2.14.0
release-manager: Kicking off production promotion (rolling) — expected ~8m. will update status. change window still 23:00-03:00.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: target=prod strategy=rolling batch_size=10% commit=3f7a9b tag=v2.14.0
sre-bot: Post-promotion check: first 2 batches OK. p95=195ms errors=0.1%. no abnormalities in traces.
alice.nguyen: :thumbsup: logs look good, continue remainder of batches.
deploy-bot: Promotion finished: status=success duration=7m48s tag=v2.14.0
release-manager: Notes for release notes: v2.14.0 — kv cache warming improvements, kernel selection tweak for long sequences, reduced tail latency in common paths. Reminder: if rollback needed pin traffic to v2.13.7 and open SEV.
jordan: Quick ops note: keep handy the rollback command — `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.13.7 -n prod`
alice.nguyen: Adding post-deploy checklist: run smoke tests, update perf dashboards, notify top-tier customers.
deploy-bot: Deployment summary: service=runtime-api env=prod from=1%->100% canary=10% start=1767890123 promote_start=1767890540 promote_end=1767890820 commit=3f7a9b tag=v2.14.0
